description: Live level-2 order book (bids + asks, each with price, aggregate size, and order count) for one Hyperliquid perp or spot symbol, from Hyperliquid's public info API ({"type":"l2Book"}). Returns two arrays — bids (best first, descending price) and asks (best first, ascending price) — each entry {px, sz, n}. Use `depth` to trim to the top N levels per side; Hyperliquid itself returns the full book (often 20+ levels per side) when depth is omitted.

coin.description: Perp symbol (e.g. "BTC") or spot pair id (e.g. "@0" from hyperliquid_spot_meta, or the canonical name like "PURR/USDC").

depth.description: Levels to keep per side, best-first (default: all levels Hyperliquid returns, typically 20+). Pass e.g. 5 for just the top of book.

name: hyperliquid_l2_book
title: Hyperliquid L2 Book
